basic_details.job_title: BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani (BITS Pilani) has announced 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post on a project-based and contractual basis for a tenure of 2 years in Goa. The candidate qualification for this post requires a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate in Professional Course with NET/GATE or national level examinations. The notified pay is Rs. 37,000 + HRA. Eligible applicants can apply online by submitting the Google Form link or by emailing their CV with details of research experience on or before 1 November 2026 at 23:59 IST.

how_to_apply: Fill out the application via the online Google Form link.
Alternatively, send your application via email to [email protected] or [email protected].
Attach a recent curriculum vitae containing details of research experience(s) while submitting the form or email.
Submit your application on or before 01st November 2026, 23:59 IST.

content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance

rows.details: Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani (BITS Pilani)
Department of Chemical Engineering, K. K. Birla Goa Campus, Goa
Bio-Oil to Green Hydrogen Production and Scale-Up Demonstration
Rs. 37,000 + HRA (as per norms and experience of the candidate)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests- CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The Selection process through National level examinations conducted by central Government departments and their agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, IIT, IISc, IISER etc. Desired Skillset: Interest in waste upcycling and decarbonization research; knowledge of process design and development and acquaintance with process modelling tools such as ASPEN.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a fellowship of Rs. 37,000 plus HRA, determined according to the norms and experience of the candidate. The appointment is purely on a contractual basis for a duration of 2 years. Hostel accommodation will be provided subject to availability and will be governed by the rules and regulations of the Institute prevailing at the time of joining. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Fill out the application via the online Google Form link. Alternatively, send your application via email to [email protected] or [email protected] . Attach a recent curriculum vitae containing details of research experience(s) while submitting the form or email. Submit your application on or before 01st November 2026, 23:59 IST.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and project requirements. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email for an online or personal interview to be held at the BITS Pilani Campus. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.answer: Desirable skills include an interest in waste upcycling and decarbonization research, knowledge of process design and development, and acquaintance with process modelling tools such as ASPEN.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates selected for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and project requirements, and only shortlisted individuals will be contacted via email for an online or personal interview at the BITS Pilani Campus.
